service.description: Implements standard MCP resources/list by discovering all static and dynamic resources under component mcp/resources directories and registered DB facets.

parameter.name: category
parameter.description: Filter by top-level category: screen, service, entity, rules, intent, discussion

parameter.name: targetComponent
parameter.description: Filter by component name (e.g. agi-ide, nursinghome)

parameter.name: subCategory
parameter.description: Filter by sub-category: archetype, schema, etc.

parameter.name: resources
parameter.description: List of MCP Resource descriptor maps

actions.script:
import java.io.File import java.nio.file.Path import java.nio.file.Paths import groovy.io.FileType import org.moqui.resource.ResourceReference
List results = [] File compBase = new File("runtime/component")
def getMimeType = { String filename -> if (filename.endsWith('.xml')) return 'application/xml' if (filename.endsWith('.json')) return 'application/json' if (filename.endsWith('.md')) return 'text/markdown' if (filename.endsWith('.groovy')) return 'text/x-groovy' if (filename.endsWith('.qvt.js')) return 'application/javascript' return 'text/plain' }
if (compBase.exists() && compBase.isDirectory()) { compBase.eachDir { File compDir -> String cName = compDir.name if (targetComponent && cName != targetComponent) return
File mcpResourcesDir = new File(compDir, "mcp/resources") if (mcpResourcesDir.exists() && mcpResourcesDir.isDirectory()) { Path basePath = mcpResourcesDir.toPath()
mcpResourcesDir.eachFileRecurse(FileType.FILES) { File f -> if (f.name.startsWith(".")) return
Path relPath = basePath.relativize(f.toPath()) String relPathStr = relPath.toString().replace('\\', '/') String[] segments = relPathStr.split('/')
String cat = segments.length > 0 ? segments[0] : "general" String subCat = segments.length > 2 ? segments[1] : "" String fileName = f.name String baseName = fileName.replaceAll('\\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$', '')
if (category && cat != category) return if (subCategory && subCat != subCategory) return
String mcpUri = "mcp://${cName}/resources/${relPathStr}" String compUri = "component://${cName}/mcp/resources/${relPathStr}"
// Gather optional DB metadata facets if entity exists Map metadata = [ component: cName, category: cat, subCategory: subCat, fileName: fileName, baseName: baseName, location: compUri ]
try { def facetList = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.mcp.McpResourceFacet") .condition("resourceUri", mcpUri) .list() facetList.each { facet -> metadata[facet.facetKey] = facet.facetValue } } catch (Exception ignored) { // Entity not yet loaded in current migration step }
results.add([ uri: mcpUri, name: baseName, description: "${cat.toUpperCase()}${subCat ? ' ' + subCat.toUpperCase() : ''}: ${baseName} (${cName})", mimeType: getMimeType(fileName), category: cat, subCategory: subCat, component: cName, metadata: metadata ]) } } } }
context.resources = results ec.logger.info("📦 [get#ResourceList] Discovered ${results.size()} MCP resources")
